Axiscades to Acquire Cloud Wave Technologies for Rs 260 Crore

Axiscades Technologies announced its plan to acquire 90% of Cloud Wave Technologies for Rs 260 crore. This acquisition is intended to accelerate Axiscades' entry into the aerospace manufacturing sector. Following the announcement, Axiscades' shares saw a 2% increase.
